description: This PHP class 'SearchDefsDocumentifier' converts SugarBean objects into searchable document representations within the SuiteCRM framework, utilizing search definitions and mapping configurations.

classes.name: SearchDefsDocumentifier
classes.description: A class that converts SugarBean objects into indexable documents using configurable search definitions and mapping.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the logger and mapping configuration for the documentifier.

methods.name: documentify
methods.description: Converts a SugarBean into a searchable document array, applying field parsing and data mapping.

methods.name: getFieldsToIndex
methods.description: Retrieves and caches the list of fields to index for a given module based on search definitions.

methods.name: getFieldsToIndexCached
methods.description: Returns cached fields to index for a module, loading them if not already cached.

methods.name: parseBeans
methods.description: Extracts relevant property values from a SugarBean based on specified fields to prepare the document body.
